```{mermaid}
flowchart TB

    subgraph User Layer
        Scientist[Scientists]
        Reviewer[Reviewers]
        Stakeholder[Stakeholders]
    end

    subgraph Source Control
        GitHub[GitHub Repositories]
    end

    subgraph Repository Management
        Sync[Repository Sync Service]
        Storage["Repository Store<br/>File System / Azure Blob"]
    end

    subgraph Processing Layer

        Validation[TAF Validation Engine]

        Execution[TAF Execution Engine]

        Containers["Container Runtime<br/>Docker / Azure Containers"]

    end

    subgraph Application Layer

        Angular[Angular Portal]

        API[ASP.NET Core API]

    end

    subgraph Data Layer

        Metadata["(Metadata Database)"]

        OutputStore["(Output Repository)"]

    end

    subgraph Discovery Layer

        Explorer["TAF Explorer<br/>R Shiny"]

    end


    Scientist --> GitHub

    GitHub --> Sync

    Sync --> Storage

    Storage --> Validation

    Storage --> Execution

    Execution --> Containers

    Validation --> Metadata

    Execution --> Metadata

    Execution --> OutputStore

    Angular --> API

    API --> Metadata

    API --> OutputStore

    Scientist --> Angular
    Reviewer --> Angular

    Explorer --> Metadata
    Explorer --> OutputStore

    Stakeholder --> Explorer
```
